summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting amendments to its Memorandum and Articles of Association, adopted by shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting on June 16, 2026, and filed with the Cayman Islands Registrar on June 25, 2026. The filing includes the adoption of a third amended and restated M&A, which updates corporate governance documents. No specific terms, prices, premiums, or deal mechanics are provided. This is a routine corporate housekeeping filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing does not involve any deal terms or strategic change beyond standard governance updates.
